title: Convert all website content to English and add white color accents to the design

requirements.text: Convert all user-facing text throughout the website to English. This includes all headings, subheadings, taglines, button labels, section titles, card text, placeholder text, error messages, and any other visible copy in every component (HeroSection, ServicesSection, AboutSection, ContactSection, FAQSection, FeedbackSection, HowItWorksSection, TrustStatsBar, Header, NavigationDrawer, Footer, ScrollLoginPopup, ScrollRatingPopup, ProfileModal, FloatingCallButton, FloatingWhatsAppButton). Replace any Hindi, mixed-language, or non-English text with clear English equivalents that preserve the original meaning and tone.

quotes: Convert all website content/text to English (all headings, buttons, section text, labels)

acceptanceCriteria: Every visible text element across all components is in English
HeroSection headline, tagline, and CTA buttons are in English
NavigationDrawer and Header menu items are in English
ServicesSection card titles, descriptions, and CTA are in English
AboutSection, ContactSection, FAQSection, FeedbackSection headings and body text are in English
HowItWorksSection step titles and descriptions are in English
TrustStatsBar labels are in English
ScrollLoginPopup and ScrollRatingPopup text, prompts, and buttons are in English
Footer copyright and nav links are in English
ProfileModal form labels and buttons are in English
No Hindi or mixed-language strings remain in any rendered component

requirements.text: Enhance the visual design by mixing white accents into the existing dark theme to make the website more attractive and visually distinct. Apply the following changes across all components: (1) Service cards, feedback review cards, FAQ accordion items, HowItWorksSection step cards, and ContactSection info cards should use white or off-white card backgrounds (e.g., #ffffff or rgba(255,255,255,0.06)–0.10) with dark text, creating a contrast against the dark page background; (2) Add white/light-tinted section dividers or subtle white borders between major sections; (3) TrustStatsBar and HowItWorksSection connector lines can use white/light accents; (4) Form inputs in FeedbackSection, ProfileModal, and ScrollRatingPopup should have white or light-bordered inputs; (5) Maintain the existing #FFD700/#FF8C42 accent colors for headings, icons, and CTA buttons — do not replace them; (6) Ensure sufficient contrast: dark text on white card backgrounds, white text on dark section backgrounds; (7) Apply the white card / light accent treatment consistently so the overall effect is a polished dark-and-white mixed theme.

Do not alter any SEO meta tags, JSON-LD structured data, or Google Search Console verification tag in frontend/index.html
All WhatsApp links, phone links, and email links must remain functional and unchanged
